record.title: Sagittarius: nature

source_locator.printed_page_policy: Use READING_RECEIPT page map; original labels are not uniformly PDF minus 34.

record.source_statement: Fiery triplicity, East, fiery/hot/dry, masculine, choleric, diurnal, common/bicorporeal/double-bodied; house and joy of Jupiter.
prerequisites: Use the relevant-topic selection and combination procedure in XVII.
qualifications_and_limits: Historical catalogue, not established present-day clinical, demographic or geographical classification.
Country/city spellings are lightly normalized for legibility; territories, qualifiers and surprising assignments are retained, not geocoded.

record.title: Mixed-motion application
record.source_statement: Direct Mars Aries 15 to retrograde Mercury Aries 17: ill application, great atmospheric change or sudden alteration in a question.
prerequisites: Direct planet lower, retrograde planet higher.
qualifications_and_limits: Weather and question outcomes are different reference frames; no exact forecast from these illustrative coordinates.

record.title: Application and weight hierarchy
record.source_statement: Lighter planets apply to more ponderous ones; superior planets do not apply to inferior ones unless retrograde. Saturn Aries 10 receives applications from Mars at degree 7 of Aries, Gemini, Cancer, Leo or Libra by conjunction, sextile, square, trine or opposition respectively.
qualifications_and_limits: Exact contact described at matching degree and minute; a complete event calculation requires both trajectories.

record.title: Translation, introductory definition
record.source_statement: A light planet separates from a weightier planet and presently joins another weightier one, bodily or by aspect. Mercury Aries 16 takes Mars Aries 15 toward Saturn Aries 20.
prerequisites: Intermediary is the appropriate lighter carrier.
qualifications_and_limits: XXI adds explicit reception and no-intervening-contact conditions for its perfection route; retain both scopes.

record.title: Translation perfection prerequisites
record.source_statement: Principals have separated from conjunction, sextile or trine. A third planet separates from one who receives it by domicile, triplicity OR term, then applies to the other before meeting ANY other conjunction or aspect.
prerequisites: Reception direction is source principal receiving intermediary.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not silently add face/exaltation to this locally enumerated list or omit reception by borrowing the shorter XIX definition.

record.title: Translation identifies practical mediator
record.source_statement: The translating planet or its represented person brings the matter to perfection; its house rulership identifies means: second lord a purse, third lord kin or neighbour.
qualifications_and_limits: The intermediary's role is not another independent natal character score.

record.title: Case direction combines quadrant with sign
record.source_statement: Sun near ninth cusp and moveable Aries suggest sudden travel; southern quadrant plus eastern sign gives southeast from London. Sun-cusp separation is2:10 and departure is reported within two months.
qualifications_and_limits: Direction interpretation and actual reported departure are different evidence fields. Position is after the cusp; no invented forward-cusp contact time.

record.title: Case country and within-country direction are separate levels
record.source_statement: Aries countries are proposed; staying in England would favour its eastern/southeastern areas. When a sign-associated country lies in another compass direction, conduct affairs within the favourable part of that country; France southwest of London is illustrated with its east/southeast portion.
qualifications_and_limits: The country-association and direction criteria are not independent empirical corroboration; fallback scope must be declared before testing.

record.title: At-home question: asker and unrelated familiar person
record.source_statement: Ascendant and its lord represent the asker; seventh and its lord represent the familiar person to be visited, when not related.
prerequisites: Question is whether the asker will find that person at home.
qualifications_and_limits: Do not use this seventh-house assignment for every possible absent-person question.

record.title: At-home question: relatives replace generic seventh
prerequisites: Choose the actual relationship before selecting the house ruler.
qualifications_and_limits: Sibling/neighbour illustration is in XXV p154; the named roles are not a complete arbitrary-relationship ontology.

record.title: General absent stranger: a different first-house frame
record.source_statement: For a general absent-person question with no relation to the asker, first house, its lord and Moon signify the absent party.
qualifications_and_limits: Local exception to the seventh-house at-home role; the exact question matters.

record.title: Question time: actual request
record.source_statement: Use the moment the querent propounds the desire to the astrologer.
qualifications_and_limits: Historical question chart, not native birth time or arbitrary first mention of a person.

record.title: Question time: delayed letter
record.source_statement: For a letter delivered earlier and read four/five hours later, use hour/minute when opened and the querent's intention is perceived, not mere delivery time.
qualifications_and_limits: Does not define modern asynchronous AI first-read/reprocessing semantics; those would require a separately declared convention.

record.title: Self-question: reported objection and author's alternative
record.source_statement: Lilly reports Bonatus and others warning against judging one's own question; he conjectures concern about partiality. He permits a genuinely troubling self-question at its arising time if impartial, urging all favour to one's cause be laid aside.
qualifications_and_limits: The reason attributed to Bonatus is Lilly's conjecture, not a checked quotation from Bonatus. Self-reported success is not blinded evidence.

qualifications_and_limits: These local units are not the sign-modality news scale or a universal Lilly timing rule. Fractional unit/calendar conventions are not defined.

record.title: Timing units depend on plausible business duration

source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

record.source_statement: Consider whether the business can be completed in days, weeks or months. For a lengthy business, years may replace months, especially when Ascendant lord, Moon and other significators are angular.
qualifications_and_limits: No objective long-business threshold or automatic promotion rule is supplied. Do not choose a unit after seeing the outcome.

record.title: Mix reason with art in contingent timing

source_locator.passage_anchor: As also when you judge in this nature through Abs te and Scientia
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

record.source_statement: For contingent things Lilly says to measure when events will happen according to reason, combining art and reason and not relying excessively on general rules of art.
qualifications_and_limits: This is an explicit judgmental qualification; no algorithmic selection rule for months versus years is provided here.

record.title: Hard-aspect reception can fail with ill disposition

source_locator.passage_anchor: You must notwithstanding judge through the lesse when he that is received
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

record.source_statement: Reception by square or opposition profits nothing when a planet is ill-disposed, and still less when the received planet is impedited.
qualifications_and_limits: The exact identity of a Planet in the first clause is not fully explicit; the succeeding well-disposed-receiver exception must be retained.

record.title: Sextile or trine reception and well-disposed receiver exception

source_locator.passage_anchor: But if reception be by sextile or trine through be the aspect square or opposition
source_locator.anchor_note: Locating incipit/topic; long-s, spacing and glyph names normalized. Not a diplomatic quotation.

record.source_statement: Reception by sextile or trine gives confidence of accomplishment; if the receiving planet is well-disposed, reception by any aspect can perform the matter, including square or opposition.
qualifications_and_limits: This qualifies the preceding rejection of ill-conditioned hard-aspect reception.
